greeting: A short, personal list today, Dan — Juliano by mid-morning, clothes in the mail, and the drive to Rockland at noon with the Forester keys. Mike's recovering from surgery, so the evening stays soft and quiet.

needsAttention.title: Croatia gear order is stuck
needsAttention.detail: The sailing-gear checkout can't go through until Mike sends his sizes and picks — duffel color, boat-shoe model, and both your shoe sizes. Flagged P1 on your shared board.

needsAttention.title: Sunday's NYC dinner has no table yet
needsAttention.detail: Sunday's dinner for two is confirmed but the reservation isn't — a direct call for bar or counter seats still lands easily at 48 hours out. P1 on your board.

schedule.title: Mike recovering
schedule.detail: Rest day after oral surgery; keep it light

inbox.noise: The rest is promotions, a LinkedIn job digest, and an Evite reunion note — nothing that needs a reply.
inbox.clear: Inbox is quiet, and the Valoris call is already on the books.

resolved.title: Valoris call is set
resolved.detail: Martin Steindl confirmed and sent the invite — your catch-up with the group is booked for Thursday the 27th at 12:00 EST.

recipe.title: Roast Sugar-Sprinkled Peaches
recipe.why: Peaches are at their late-summer peak, when a hot oven and a little sugar are all they need.

acts.line: Juliano stops by around 9:30, and the clothes go in the mail before noon.
The drive to Rockland leaves at noon, Forester keys in hand, pointing you toward the island.
Nothing on the calendar; with Mike recovering, it's a soft, low-key night.
